purpose: Find a physically appropriate finite-time rainfall-ponding fixture after R2A showed that the E3G wet-top profile dries under sub-capacity forcing. R2B changes only the initial hydraulic profile class, not solver tolerances or event semantics.

frozen_scope.capacity_reference: same endpoint-aware full-accuracy 5 cm surface-face reference

forcing_policy.definition: For each material/profile compute qcap0 from the committed top-node head. Then q_supply = KSAT + lambda*(qcap0-KSAT).
physical_guards: Every lambda forcing is strictly above KSAT and strictly below qcap0 at t0.
No material-specific numerical forcing constants are introduced.

event_signature.valid_bracket: Two adjacent sampled times t_a<t_b with both dry reference states solver-successful, mass-valid and inside the negative-head scope, with g(t_a)<-tol_a and g(t_b)>=-tol_b.
event_signature.required_wetting_direction: h_top(t_b)>h_top(t_a), so the event is approached by wetting rather than the R2A drying mechanism.

deterministic_fixture_selection_if_multi.primary_score: maximize min(abs(g_left),abs(g_right))/KSAT over valid adjacent brackets
deterministic_fixture_selection_if_multi.meaning: Selection rewards a numerically robust sign bracket without changing the physical event criterion.

interpretation_rules.pass_per_material: At least one valid wetting-direction finite-time bracket exists in the frozen profile/forcing/time grid.
interpretation_rules.fail_per_material: No finite-time fixture is admitted from this grid; do not add profiles or times inside R2B after seeing results.
interpretation_rules.qualification_effect: None. R2B only selects a physical fixture for a later separately precommitted event-localization qualification.

architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: All trajectory samples are immutable trials from the same committed state.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Sample times are generic offsets, not calendar boundaries.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Only states within the existing 1e-9 cm mass gate can bracket an event.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Dry initial profiles and supply are physical fixtures; the finite sample grid is qualification-only policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: The characterization grid is finite and bounded; it is not proposed as production event search.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Fixture selection is established by full-accuracy reference physics only.
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: Profiles, bottom boundary, face lengths, times and forcing construction are explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No finite-time event localization is qualified by R2B.
No candidate event locator or production search policy is tested.
No claim that either dry profile is a universal production initialization.
No B12/O13 finite-time event is sought; their R1/no-event separation remains authoritative.
No top-node positive head, depletion switch, runoff, tangent, runtime, MultiSWAP or MODFLOW admission.
